acceptance: Suggestions appear only for mechanical findings on non-gate, non-soundness lines inside the diff, with an exact span (tests, including refusal cases).
Hostile replacement text cannot break out of the suggestion fence (tests).
With the flag off nothing changes; with it on, one live Theseus PR shows a working suggestion that a later review treats as ordinary code.
context: 2026-11-13: Released in Theseus v0.2.12 (#81). Enabled for Theseus (#84) and BenchBox (#4215). Remaining: one live PR with a mechanical finding shows a working suggestion block; the eval did not record suggestions.
description:
Owner decision 2026-11-13: build suggestion blocks (proposal section 8.6 option 3). For a mechanical fix (a typo, an import, a constant) the finding thread includes a ```suggestion block covering the exact line span, so the author can commit it in one click.
Constraints:
- Opt-in through a consumer policy flag, default false.
- Never offered on gate paths, soundness paths or the policy, lock and workflow files.
- Only when the reviewer marks the fix mechanical and supplies replacement text for lines inside the diff hunk.
- Fence-safe: the replacement cannot close the block or inject markdown.
- Exact line span, validated against the head.
- The thread still states the finding and the dispute footer.
- A committed suggestion is reviewed like any other change on the next head; it gets no trust from having been suggested.
Needs a reviewer-brief change, so it goes through the same evaluation as theseus-review-structured-findings-20261110 (manual comparison, spend approved for those runs).
Guardrails: Theseus merge rule G7 (hosted SHIP + green checks + independent review of the exact final head); markers, fingerprints and the review-protocol record unchanged; verdict reviews and threads never edited after posting unless this item says otherwise; no owner-only actions; shipped through a Theseus release and the BenchBox and Theseus locks.
